Exercise six. Rain. Wet places have more cloud, more rain, more rivers, and more of everything that grows. Dry places have less of everything, including hope. You have been given the rainfall map and the rivers. It is very wet here. Guess somewhere just as wet. As nobody can measure rain by looking at it, anywhere in the wetter half of the planet will do.
